title: LEGEND
description: this project adds a bunch of cobblemon addons and fun stuff like mega evos and za megas, zmoves, dynamax and tera! if you enjoy cobblemon and want a semi full pokemon experience,download this modpack! please? anyway fyi this modpack is fairly big
body:
Step into a world where every tall patch of grass hides danger, every mountain peak promises discovery, and every battle could turn the tide of your journey…

Welcome to **the ultimate Cobblemon adventure modpack** — where classic monster-catching vibes collide with over-the-top power mechanics and just the right amount of chaos.

This isn’t your peaceful “collect and chill” experience (well… it *can* be, until something with glowing eyes charges at you). Here, your team isn’t just strong — it’s *legendary in the making*.

Harness the raw intensity of:

* **Mega Evolution** — push your partners beyond their limits mid-battle
* **Z-Moves** — unleash cinematic, fight-ending attacks that make you feel like the main character
* **ZA Megas** — because normal Mega Evolution clearly wasn’t dramatic enough
* **Terastallization (Tera)** — rewrite typings and flip battles on their head
* **Dynamax** — go big. No, seriously… *really big*

Every encounter is a chance to test strategy, luck, and maybe your ability to not panic-click the wrong move.

Explore vast biomes, build your dream team, challenge powerful opponents, and prove that you’re not just another trainer who picked their starter because it “looked cute” (no judgment… okay, maybe a little).

Whether you’re battling friends, conquering the wild, or just trying to survive that one overleveled monster that absolutely should not be where it is — this modpack delivers **adventure, spectacle, and just a hint of friendly suffering**.

So grab your gear, prepare your team, and remember:

If your plan isn’t working… you probably just need a bigger transformation.

**Your journey starts now.**
HAVE FUN!! :))
